exportAll.description: ZIP ine dataset imwe neimwe seCSV pamwe ne<mono>data.json</mono>, snapshot yematafura ose. Minda yakavanzwa nemucrypto (zvikamu zvenzira dzekubhadhara, password yeSMTP) haiendi; README mukati inozvinyora.

exportDocuments.title: Export zvinyorwa
exportDocuments.description: Invoice nePDF yecredit note imwe neimwe yakapiwa kana yakabviswa mukati menguva, yakatumidzwa nenhamba, ine <mono>index.csv</mono> yenhamba, totals nema hashes. MaPDF asipo anogadzirwa panzira.

backups.description: Compose <mono>backup</mono> service inotora dump yePostgres uye inoarchive storage volume pa<mono>BACKUP_CRON</mono>, inochengeta <mono>BACKUP_RETENTION_DAYS</mono> enhoroondo mu<mono>backups</mono> volume, uye inyora status file yainoverenga peji iri.
